_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: Oracle University, Exam 1Z0-830: Java SE 21 Developer Professional (Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 21 Developer): exam topics on the Oracle MyLearn exam page
_items_source.version: 1Z0-830 exam topics as published on Oracle MyLearn, fetched live 2026-09-26
_items_source.numbering: Oracle lists the objectives under 10 headed areas plus a closing 'Candidates are also expected to' list, all without numbers; ids number them area.position in the page's order (1.1-10.1), and the closing list is area 11 (11.1-11.3).

_syllabus_items.title: Use primitives and wrapper classes; evaluate arithmetic and boolean expressions using the Math API, precedence rules, type conversions and casting
_syllabus_items.topic_area: 1 Handling Date, Time, Text, Numeric and Boolean Values

_syllabus_items.title: Manipulate text, including text blocks, using the String and StringBuilder classes
_syllabus_items.topic_area: 1 Handling Date, Time, Text, Numeric and Boolean Values

_syllabus_items.title: Manipulate date, time, duration, period, instant and time-zone objects, including daylight saving time, using the Date-Time API
_syllabus_items.topic_area: 1 Handling Date, Time, Text, Numeric and Boolean Values

_syllabus_items.title: Create program flow control constructs, including if/else, switch statements and expressions, loops, and break and continue
Declare and instantiate Java objects, including nested class objects, and explain the object life-cycle: creation, reassigning references and garbage collection
Create classes and records, and define and use instance and static fields and methods, constructors, and instance and static initializers
Implement overloaded methods, including var-arg methods
Understand variable scopes, apply encapsulation, create immutable objects, and use local variable type inference

Implement inheritance with abstract and sealed types and records; override methods including Object's; polymorphism, object vs reference type, reference casting, instanceof, and pattern matching with instanceof and switch
Create and use interfaces, identify functional interfaces, and use private, static and default interface methods
Create and use enum types with fields, methods and constructors
Handle exceptions using try/catch/finally, try-with-resources and multi-catch blocks, including custom exceptions
Create arrays, List, Set, Map and Deque collections, and add, remove, update, retrieve and sort their elements
Use object and primitive streams, with lambda expressions implementing functional interfaces, to create, filter, transform, process and sort data
_syllabus_items.topic_area: 6 Working with Streams and Lambda Expressions

_syllabus_items.title: Perform decomposition, concatenation and reduction, and grouping and partitioning, on sequential and parallel streams
_syllabus_items.topic_area: 6 Working with Streams and Lambda Expressions

_syllabus_items.title: Define modules and expose module content, including by reflection; declare module dependencies; define services, providers and consumers
Compile Java code; create modular and non-modular jars and runtime images; migrate to modules using unnamed and automatic modules
Create platform and virtual threads; use Runnable and Callable; manage the thread life-cycle; use Executor services and the concurrent API to run tasks
Develop thread-safe code using locking mechanisms and the concurrent API
Process Java collections concurrently and use parallel streams
Read and write console and file data using I/O streams
Serialize and deserialize Java objects
Construct, traverse, create, read and write Path objects and their properties using the java.nio.file API
Implement localization using locales and resource bundles; parse and format messages, dates, times and numbers, including currency and percentage values
Understand the basics of the Java Logging API
Use annotations such as Override, FunctionalInterface, Deprecated, SuppressWarnings and SafeVarargs
Use generics, including wildcards
